content.text:
Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Repo: inkling (Electron + React + TypeScript + Vite, Bun, Windows app). Read AGENTS.md at the repo root and follow it (performance principles, taste, verifying, comment rules enforced by `inkling/no-low-value-comments`, every `oxlint-disable` needs ` -- reason`). Do the work yourself; no subagents. Do NOT launch dev servers or the Electron app (the parent agent does the UI pass after you).

## Goal
`.oxlintrc.json` turns off several oxlint React rules that t3code (https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code) runs as errors: `react/refs`, `react/set-state-in-effect`, `react/exhaustive-effect-dependencies`, `react/immutability`; `react/purity` is not enabled. Fix the existing violations in `src/` and turn all five rules on as `error`, so effects that just sync state stop causing cascading renders and the lint holds the line.

## Known violations (measured on main with `bunx oxlint -D react/set-state-in-effect -D react/refs -D react/immutability -D react/exhaustive-effect-dependencies -D react/purity src`): ~25 diagnostics in 14 files: 13 set-state-in-effect, 8 refs, 2 immutability, 2 exhaustive-effect-dependencies, 0 purity. Files include src/components/mascot/InklingMascot.tsx, src/features/settings/useSettings.ts, src/features/settings/useArchive.ts, src/components/onboarding/SplitText.tsx, src/features/item-view/ZoomableImage.tsx, src/features/shell/useAppShortcuts.ts, src/App.tsx, src/features/item-view/PdfViewer.tsx, src/features/item-view/RichNoteEditor.tsx, src/features/shell/SpacesSection.tsx, src/components/ItemMedia.tsx, src/components/LiquidGlass.tsx, src/features/spaces/useSpaces.ts, src/components/FirstRunOverlay.tsx. Re-run the command yourself for the exact list.

## How to fix (behavior must not change)
- set-state-in-effect: derive the value during render, reset state with a `key`, or move the update into the event handler that causes it. If the effect truly synchronizes with something outside React and a synchronous setState is required (e.g. measuring layout, subscribing to a store/observer, a one-time mount read from an external API), keep it and add `// oxlint-disable-next-line react/set-state-in-effect -- <specific reason>`; the reason must say what external thing it syncs. Prefer a real fix; use disables sparingly and justify each.
- refs: do not read or write `ref.current` during render. Typical fixes: keep the latest-callback ref updates inside an effect or layout effect, or use state/derived value. Event handlers and effects may use refs.
- immutability (src/components/LiquidGlass.tsx ~line 433): do not mutate a value from useState or reassign locals after render.
- exhaustive-effect-dependencies: remove the extra dependencies, but double check the effect really should not re-run on them.
- Hot paths matter: the library grid, card, item overlay, and mascot are performance-sensitive. Do not add renders, re-subscriptions, or work per scroll/frame. No continuously repainting animations. Do not change the mascot's timing/behavior.
- Do not add comments restating code. Keep diffs small per file; no refactors beyond what each fix needs.
- Remove the `"off"` lines for these rules in `.oxlintrc.json` and set all five to `"error"` (`react/refs`, `react/set-state-in-effect`, `react/exhaustive-effect-dependencies`, `react/immutability`, `react/purity`). Leave other rules as they are. Check the overrides section still makes sense.

## Proof
- `bunx oxlint src` and `bunx oxlint` (whole repo lint, fast) clean with the new config; `bunx oxfmt --check` on files you changed; `bun run typecheck`; `bun test` only for test files beside the files you changed (a test covering a hook you altered must pass). No full `bun test` sweep.
- If a fix changes logic that has no test and is easy to break quietly (ordering/race of state), add one focused test per AGENTS.md test rules; otherwise do not add tests.
- In the PR body list each file and the kind of fix, and call out every `oxlint-disable` you kept with its reason, so the parent can do a targeted UI pass on those areas.
- docs/changelog.md: skip unless a user-visible behavior changed (it should not).

## Delivery (full-stop: PR ready for the user, never merged by you)
- Branch from latest origin/main (`git fetch origin; git switch -c fix/react-lint-rules origin/main`).
- Conventional commit, e.g. `fix(react): stop syncing state in effects and enable the React lint rules`. End with your own `Co-Authored-By: <your model name> <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Push and open a PR with `gh` (use the `file-pr` skill if you have it). Body: problem in a sentence or two, how fixed, one line on proof, the per-file list above; end with your model name and harness `(T3 Code)`, then `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)`.
- Never merge, enable auto-merge, or call watch_pull_request; no sleeping or polling; look at check state once.
- Last line of your final message exactly: `PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>`. Above it, 4-8 lines: what you fixed, which disables remain, which fixes are riskiest for a UI pass.

Effects that only mirrored props into state caused cascading renders, and `.oxlintrc.json` had the React rules that catch this turned off (`react/refs`, `react/set-state-in-effect`, `react/exhaustive-effect-dependencies`, `react/immutability`; `react/purity` was not enabled).

All five rules are now `error`. Existing violations are fixed by deriving values, adjusting state during render, keying, or moving writes into the event that causes them. Behavior is unchanged.

Proof: `bunx oxlint` (repo-wide) clean, `bun run typecheck` clean, `oxfmt --check` on changed files, and the neighbouring `imageZoom`, `archiveGridWindow` and `mascotStore` tests pass. No UI pass yet.

## Per file
- `.oxlintrc.json`: the four rules set to `error`, `react/purity` added. Overrides unchanged.
- `src/features/settings/useSettings.ts`: tab reset on close done during render (previous-open state). The whole-library kinds reset moved to the effect cleanup.
- `src/features/settings/useArchive.ts`: selection reset, archive-unread reset and selection pruning done during render (previous-value state).
- `src/features/spaces/useSpaces.ts`: membership clear done during render. Preview-mode membership is derived with `useMemo` instead of mirrored by an effect, which also drops `localSpaceItems` from the desktop fetch deps.
- `src/components/ItemMedia.tsx`: `DetailVideoMedia` reset by `key` (set in `ItemStageMedia.tsx`). `XPostEmbed` resets embed HTML and status during render. "loading" is set by the Load click. A redundant `setEmbedHtml` was removed.
- `src/features/item-view/PdfViewer.tsx`: page clamp done during render.
- `src/features/item-view/RichNoteEditor.tsx`: error and link-draft reset done during render on body/title change. The tiptap `setContent` stays in its effect.
- `src/components/onboarding/SplitText.tsx`: dropped the extra `text` dependency (the call sites remount per screen, `text` is constant per mount).
- `src/components/FirstRunOverlay.tsx`, `src/features/item-view/ZoomableImage.tsx`, `src/features/shell/useAppShortcuts.ts`, `src/App.tsx` (`filteredItemsRef`), `src/components/LiquidGlass.tsx` (`rootsRef`): latest-value refs are now written in an effect or layout effect instead of during render.

I ran only the neighbouring `imageZoom`, `archiveGridWindow` and `mascotStore` tests (14 pass); none of them cover the changed hooks. I added no new tests and did no UI pass.

- **How I fixed them:** I reset or derived state during render, keyed remounts, moved writes into the click that causes them, and moved latest-callback refs into effects. Details per file are in the PR body.
- **Disables kept (3):**
  - `InklingMascot.tsx`, two `react/set-state-in-effect`: the frozen-frame path re-samples the mutable `BotEngine`.

- **Small deviations from a pure refactor:**
  - `useSpaces.ts`: the desktop membership fetch no longer re-runs when `localSpaceItems` changes. Preview membership is now derived instead of mirrored by an effect.
  - `SpacesSection.tsx` and `App.tsx`: the rule flagged `draft.name` because `draft` carried a ref. The new-Space input ref is now a separate `draftNameInputRef` prop.
- **Riskiest for a UI pass:** Settings open and close (tab reset, archive tab, selection mode), X post embed load, the video poster-to-player switch in the item view, the Spaces chips in the item overlay, new-Space form focus, Liquid Glass sizing, and the onboarding headline.
